meta.title: DshDataCat
meta.description: A Navicat-style database manager in the sidebar. Connect to MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Elasticsearch; create and drop databases on MySQL/PostgreSQL instances (utf8mb4 by default on MySQL); browse databases, tables, and rows with field filters; double-click cells in MySQL/PostgreSQL tables with a primary key to edit typed values and undo the last three cell edits per table; export table DDL or DDL plus data SQL; run selected or full SQL in a syntax-highlighted playground with one-click formatting; and ask the in-page AI copilot to query the selected database; the copilot is available only while the DshDataCat panel is open. AI writes and other high-risk statements need explicit confirmation. AI requests include the selected database's object names, columns, and a few sample values, and are sent to the current DSH default model. Connections are managed on the Host; data source settings, including passwords, are stored in DSH_HOME/dshcat/datasources.json on this machine.
